# components/back-to-top

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/back-to-top.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `BackToTop`

```ts
BackToTop(props = …: BackToTopProps): Html
```

A round button fixed to a bottom corner that appears once the page has
scrolled `threshold` px (back-to-top.js) and scrolls to the top —
smoothly unless the person prefers reduced motion — then moves focus to
the main content so a keyboard user lands where the page starts. Rendered
hidden; without the script it stays hidden (a static page is scrolled by
the browser's own means).

## Types

### `BackToTopPosition`

Which bottom corner the button sits in.

- `"end"`
- `"start"`

### `BackToTopProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. @default "Back to top" |
| `threshold` | `number` |  | Pixels scrolled before the button appears. @default 600 |
| `position` | `BackToTopPosition` |  |  |
| `static` | `boolean` |  | In flow, always shown (a catalogue, a footer slot) instead of fixed to the corner and shown past `threshold`. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Once per page, in the layout's footer slot

Hidden until 600px of scrolling; a click scrolls up and moves focus to `#main-content`.

```ts
BackToTop()
```

```html
<button type="button" class="back-to-top" id="back-to-top" aria-label="Back to top" title="Back to top" data-back-to-top="" data-back-to-top-threshold="600" hidden="">
  <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
</button>
```

### Sooner, in the other corner

```ts
BackToTop({ threshold: 300, position: "start", label: "Top" })
```

```html
<button type="button" class="back-to-top back-to-top--start" id="back-to-top" aria-label="Top" title="Top" data-back-to-top="" data-back-to-top-threshold="300" hidden="">
  <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
</button>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/back-to-top/back-to-top.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.back-to-top`, `.back-to-top--start`, `.back-to-top--static`, `.is-closing`, `.js`

## Behaviour

`components/back-to-top/back-to-top.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-back-to-top`, `data-back-to-top-threshold`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
